# task_sequence

Create a line-tracked sequential CAESAR task backed by DCode runtime memory.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `runtime.task_sequence` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Runtime Blocks |
| Family | Task |
| Monaco kind | `runtime_block` |
| Format | `task_sequence <portal>/<name>:` |
| Valid contexts | `file` |
| Autocomplete | `task_sequence tasks/name:<br>    sleep 1.0<br>` |

## Lifecycle

Activation creates the task; each run executes the sequence in order while publishing its current source line.

## Persistence

The state table survives sequence execution for the active runtime object.

## Runtime-memory fingerprinting

The activation source hash includes the script and template dependencies and is reported with loaded runtime memory.

## Runtime sections

- `start`
- `sequence body`
- `end`

## Generated channels

- `<portal>/<name>_running.value`
- `<portal>/<name>_target_frequency.value`
- `<portal>/<name>_actual_frequency.value`
- `<portal>/<name>_hold.value`
- `<portal>/<name>_current_line.value`

## Example

```lua
task_sequence tasks/name:
    sleep 1.0
```
